about: Lag Slóeðlu in Söngur Slóeðlu (engine/sloedla/v2/songs/sloedla.js): the record chapter 5's set is built on, "Djamm skógarins" (tools/sloedla-music.mjs preset djamm, 2026-11-09, the owner's pick). drums.mp3 and bass.mp3 are its stems as they came; band.mp3 is its other four stems (vocals, other, guitar, piano) mixed as they are (ffmpeg amix, no levelling, 128 kbps). In the stems the first beat is 0.0518 s in (the drums, theme-tempo.mjs); the whole record (src) is kept with the chapter's sources, not here.

style: explosive, joyful disco-funk party track played by a live band
